posts.author: avp2master
posts.title: Cop reqruitment.
posts.html:
Alright, i'm getting tired of fail cops rkoing and rdming for weapons, and the admins banning and blacklisting them isn't enough. There should be a system that when if you want to be a cop, you don't just press F1, click cop and BOOM, you're a cop, you can do anything if the admins aren't around.   

   Instead, we should make it that if you want to become a cop, you need to apply for it at the forums.

That way, mingebags can't really abuse cop. And if they do, they should be blacklisted. I am sick and tired of cops that don't rp, always break nlr, and rdm.
